content.text: {"concept_key":"c5-science-distance-vs-displacement","title":"Distance vs Displacement","quick":"Distance is the total path a thing travels, it only adds up. Displacement is the straight-line gap between the start point and end point, with a direction. Distance is never less than displacement.","full":"Think of Ishika walking to the kirana shop and back home. If the shop is 200m away, she walks 200m there and 200m back, so total distance = 400m. But since she ends up at the same house she started from, her displacement is 0m, because displacement only cares where she started and where she finally stopped, in a straight line with direction. Distance only tells how much ground was covered, displacement tells how far and in which direction from start to finish.","traps":["Writing distance and displacement can never be equal, forgetting they are equal for straight-line one-direction motion","Not mentioning displacement has direction while distance does not","Giving displacement as just a number without direction or without using the straight-line idea"],"misconception":"Children think distance and displacement are always the same thing, or that displacement is just a shorter name for distance.","parent_questions":[{"q":"If you walk to the terrace and back to the same spot, what is your displacement?","expected_answer_hint":"Zero, because start and end point are the same, even though distance walked is not zero."},{"q":"Does displacement need a direction mentioned, like distance does?","expected_answer_hint":"Yes, displacement must include direction (e.g., 5m east), distance is just a number with unit."}],"check_question":{"q":"A boy runs 3km to a park and comes back 3km the same way home. What is his displacement?","options":["0 km","6 km","3 km"],"correct_index":0,"right_feedback":"Correct! He ends where he started, so displacement is zero even though distance is 6km.","wrong_feedback":"Not quite. Since he returns to his starting point, displacement is 0 km, though total distance walked is 6km."},"illustration":{"scene_prompt":"A girl walking from her house to a small neighborhood shop and back home along the same street.","labels":[{"text":"Distance","position":"top"},{"text":"Displacement","position":"bottom"}]}}
